1440.aj: ヨンドンミルミョン ヨンドンクッパ １２ Jungang-daero 209beon-gil, Dong-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: I ordered one gukbap and one milmyeon. The meat in the gukbap was very tender, and the noodles in the milmyeon were similar to jjolmyeon noodles with a nice chewy texture. The food felt very authentic and true to the basics, making it a place that most people would enjoy. Most importantly, the staff were the friendliest among the famous gukbap restaurants I’ve visited. I had a very pleasant meal and left in a great…

I recently visited a fantastic restaurant located on the first floor of The Way Hotel. During lunchtime, I noticed a long queue of people eagerly waiting to get in, which piqued my curiosity. The restaurant specializes in “dumplings”, “pork soup with rice”, and ”noodles”. The taste of the food is absolutely excellent, and the prices are very reasonable. It’s no wonder there’s always a long queue here, while the…
I love their pork rice soup and I'm so glad we found this place in Busan.

1441.aj: イルミミルミョン（일미밀면） ３ Daecheong-ro 99beon-gil, Jung-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: People probably come for the wheat noodles, in a cold broth or a spicy sauce - I mean, everyone else (~25 people) who were seated before and after I arrived basically had just that. Me? I was just in town for a day and wanted to try a 돼지국밥 (dwaeji gukbap) because I love them and this little establishment that had a queue of four people ahead of me at lunch time in a place that can seat about 20 people (always a good…

Best family own restaurant to try Busan's renown dishes like Milmyeon (cold noodle) and Dwaeji Gukbap (pork rice soup)!! Make sure to mix the chili green onions, baby shrimps, red sauce and pepper to taste for the gukbap. They were delicious and flavorful!

A small place known for mil-myeon, cold flour noodles with pork & herbal broth. Mil myeon broth was so flavourful (recommend mixing with vinegar & mustard) and the noodles were cooked perfectly. My favourite meal in Busan!

1442.aj: 1층 부산약콩밀면, ８０ Dongmyeong-ro 145beon-gil, Nam-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: I don’t speak any Korean but I pointed to the second photo for this cold mixed noodles and it’s the best decision I made so far in terms of food choice here in Busan! Simply delicious, the dumplings were great too! I will definitely come back for this again. Great place to go if you are just done with your hike across Igidae!

Super yummy cold noodles! Was a little on the spicy side for me. The staff was very friendly although they spoke minimal English. A good place to eat if you are heading or done visiting the Igidae park/coastal trail.
Super delicious and healthy cold noodles! Even though they have no English menu but the store owner was kind enough to assist us.

1443.a: Oncheon-cheon, 연산제9동 Dongnae-gu, Busan, South Korea
1443.aj: 温泉川 연산제9동 Dongnae-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: If you visit during cherry blossom season, it is picturesque.
It was a lovely walk; the trees lining the stream are on the first cusps of spring, but we spotted a couple in full bloom near an apartment towards the end. The buds should open in a few days’ time!

Oncheoncheon Stream is a fantastic place for a walk. The scenery is truly beautiful, especially with the many cherry blossom trees and the river flowing through the center. In addition to leisurely strolls, it's also a great spot for outdoor activities like jogging or cycling. I visited around 4 PM, and there were a lot of people, adding to the lively atmosphere. A great place to enjoy nature and stay active!

1444.a: Bupyeong Jokbal, 19-2 광복로 Jung-gu, Busan, South Korea
1444.aj: ブピョンチョッパル １９−２ 광복로 Jung-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: Really old time atmosphere, v friendly service and they take card. V close to Jagalchi and BIFF square. Highly recommend the food, the plain pork hock is perfectly cooked and the spicy one is so delicious!! No wait on a Saturday lunch.

First time tried Jokbal, andddd I love it 😍😍 Must try when in Busan 👍🏻 There is one area which many restaurants selling Jukbal, but we chose Bupyeong Jukbal and it was the right choice 😋 we ordered 3 menu, original Jukbal, spicy jukbal and cold noodle, they are all sooo yummy 😋😍

We order the original and cold flavors of pork horks. It is served with Korean side dishes such as spicy pickled melon, shredded onions, pickled radish, pumpkin puree and some... with endless refills. Additionally, the miso soup is delicious and refillable.

1445.a: Geumsubokguk, Haeundae Headstore, 23 Jungdong 1-ro 43beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan, South Korea
1445.aj: クムスポックク ２３ Jungdong 1-ro 43beon-gil, Haeundae-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: Another bucket list spot for me, and this time it was all about pufferfish. Located right in Haeundae, it caught my attention right away. I did not realize it was Michelin Bib Gourmand at first, but after the meal, it made complete sense. This is exactly the kind of place that defines “good food at a reasonable price.” Coming from meals that often lean heavy with thick broths and bold flavors, this was a completely…

Had a wonderful meal at Geumsubokguk. The puffer fish soup was incredibly clean, light, and comforting, with a rich flavor that felt both healthy and satisfying. The fish was fresh and tender, and the variety of side dishes complemented the meal perfectly. The restaurant has a long history and is one of Busan's most well-known spots for puffer fish, so it was great to experience such a local specialty in its…

Our first time trying pufferfish! The fried pufferfish was nice and crispy, but it didn’t have much of a distinctive fish taste - more like chicken nuggets? But not bad. The non-spicy soup one was the highlight - it was a really interesting experience for first-timers. Definitely worth trying if you’re curious about pufferfish.

1446.a: Bupyeongdong Maetdol Bindaetteok, 27 Bupyeong 2-gil, Jung-gu, Busan, South Korea
1446.aj: 富平洞メットルピンデトッ 2号店 ２７ Bupyeong 2-gil, Jung-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: Hidden gem I stumbled upon by chance. I’ve never been much of a nokdujeon (Korean mung bean pancake)녹두전 person, so I had never intentionally gone to a restaurant specializing in Korean pancakes. I stopped by this place simply hoping to enjoy a glass of makgeolli and ordered the nokdujeon 녹두전 and fish cake soup 오뎅탕. With no expectations, I took my first bite of the pancake and was genuinely blown away. It was…

Good pancakes and good ingredients. We had the beef one and seafood one. They also have a big variety of rice wine. So great if you like makgeolli. I just feel the food is quite expensive for what it is (pancakes!) that’s why the four stars. Still good though. We spent around 50,000 in two for two pancakes, a beer and a makgeolli, which I feel it’s quite a lot for Busan

I have never seen such a wide variety of Korean pancakes in my life. The original mung bean pancake with pork/seafood was our favourite and pan fried to perfection. The green onion oyster pancake had a rather different texture that was less crispy and more eggy instead. We did not enjoy it as much as the green onion was too overpowering.

1447.aj: 富平ヤンコプチャン １７ Bupyeong 2-gil, Jung-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: It had such a classic, local Korean vibe and I absolutely loved it. The whole area was lively, and the outdoor grilling style made the experience even better. Their signature yang gopchang was fresh, juicy, and surprisingly easy to eat with almost no strong odor, which made it perfect to pair with drinks. The stone-grilled yangnyeom was especially flavorful, with the sauce really soaking into everything — super…
Good place to try beef intestines, both BBQ and hotpot way provided. Taste is good and amazing service. Big pot is perfect for 2-3 people.

12112025 The restaurant is located in the public market. The place is clean, and the staff are nice. They also cook the food for you. If you are craving both gopchang and samgyupsal, this is the place to be.

rv.t: Visited Haeundae Market and it’s such a fun and vibrant place to explore! The market is packed with different street food stalls and small eateries, making it perfect for food trips and trying local Korean snacks. Everything feels lively and authentic—from fresh seafood to classic Korean street food like tteokbokki and hotteok. Prices are reasonable, and there are plenty of options to choose from, so you can easily…

Surprisingly, this market isn’t very big, it’s basically just one long street. If you’re simply walking through, you can probably finish the whole route in about 30 minutes. Along the way, there are many stalls selling fresh fruits and a variety of local foods. One thing that really caught my attention was seeing fresh eel being sold you can actually watch them cut it right in front of the street. It was a bit…

Kitty and I enjoyed a slow leisurely walk around this wonderful traditional market during our time in Busan. It has a lively authentic atmosphere that gives you a true feel of everyday local life. There are countless small stalls and shops lined up along the narrow lanes selling all kinds of fresh seafood seasonal fruits local vegetables handmade snacks and a great variety of souvenirs. We were especially happy to…

1449.a: Jeoryeong coastal path, 650-4 Yeongseon-dong 4(sa)-ga, Yeongdo-gu, Busan, South Korea
1449.aj: Jeoryeong coastal path, ６５０−４ Yeongseon-dong 4(sa)-ga, Yeongdo-gu, Busan, 韓国
catj: ハイキング コース

rv.t: The coastal walk has been temporarily closed for repair works. We were unable to walk along this walkway along the sea shore during our visit in early November 2025. We walk on another path in front of the cafes and shops on the cliff above. A nice place to enjoy the sea view and breeze.

A really awesome and beautiful walk along the coast and cliff line offering beautiful views of the ocean, tiny islands, and views of the city. Some parts are easy but other parts are not as easy. It is quite a walk but children from around six would be able to do it. Moreover, you can also find small shops, cafes, and restaurants along the way.

Fantastic spot with a lot of restaurants and cafes. Called Korean Santorini, has a scenic view on sea. Would recommend to visit in the morning as there might be less people than in the evening. However it is a fantastic spot to see the sunset so bear that in mind.

1450.a: Songdo Sky Park, 181 Amnamgongwon-ro, Seo-gu, Busan, South Korea
1450.aj: Songdo Sky Park, １８１ Amnamgongwon-ro, Seo-gu, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: Songdo Sky Park is an absolute must-visit if you are in Busan! The views from the top are spectacular, offering a panoramic look at the city skyline, the ocean, and the surrounding bridges. ​One of the highlights of the park is the whimsical art installations scattered around the viewing deck. Seeing the iconic Little Prince statue alongside the giant red rose adds a magical, fairy-tale charm to the stunning coastal…

It's not o ly a skyline. There is a park on the top station; Korean style where you enjoy it and take memorable photos with the Little prince and T-rex to name a few. The have a natural sanctuary where you can hike the trail and a suspension bridge that lead to an island for for awesome viewing of Busan, the water and the bridge.

The National Museum of Korea is the largest museum in South Korea. It displays thousands of artifacts related to Korean history, art, and culture from ancient times to the modern era. The museum includes exhibitions of traditional pottery, Buddhist sculptures, royal treasures, and historical documents. Visitors can also enjoy multimedia presentations that make Korean history easier to understand. The museum is very…

1451.aj: 松島雲の散策路 １２９−４ 암남동 Seo-gu, Busan, 韓国
1451.ed: Winding walkway at Songdo Beach, with views of a lighthouse & a cable car line overhead.

rv.t: July 2026 This is the longest of the 3 major skywalks in Busan and overlooks Busan's oldest beach. The path, which has 2 ways to enter, is in the form of a dragon's body. It's a free experience where you can walk at your own pace. The path connects to Turtle Island and extends out over the ocean. You get great views of the water, the city, and the cable cars above. I guess it used to have some glass bottoms that…

I really loved this boardwalk-style area. It was such a nice walk and honestly one of my favorites. I visited during the day and it was already beautiful, so I can only imagine how gorgeous it must be during sunset. It’s completely free, which is always a plus, and I’d definitely recommend walking all the way to the end of the path before heading toward the cable cars. There are lots of great little coffee shops and…

Cable care ride at Songdo beach is very scenic and fun. The cable car starts at 9 am and run all day until evening time. It takes you to Amnam Park which is completely free. There are restaurants and spots on the top floor for sign seeing and different art to take pictures.

1452.aj: 〒169-0072 東京都新宿区大久保２丁目３２−６ ROZI coffee
catj: コーヒーショップ・喫茶店
1452.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious and unique yakgwa sandwiches, along with a wide variety of other baked goods and coffee. They also highlight the calm and spacious atmosphere, featuring antique-style furniture and ample seating. Visitors appreciate the convenient waiting room and the option to adjust Americano strength.
1452.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、美味しくて珍しいヤッカサンドが楽しめるというクチコミが多くあります。他にも様々な種類の焼き菓子やコーヒーが提供されているようです。店内はアンティーク調の家具が置かれ、広々としていて落ち着いた雰囲気も高く評価されています。席の間隔もゆったりと取られており、快適に過ごせるという声もあります。また、便利な待合室が用意されている点や、アメリカンコーヒーの濃さを自分で調整できる点も好評です。

rv.t: Are these concrete pastries? Also, I initially just wanted to have some pastries but they said it’s not allowed to dine in if you’re not getting a drink. Understandable. You’ll need a drink after chocking from their pastries. :D
Cute coffee shop with two floors and a cozy interior. The matcha pastry I tried was amazing and a great pairing with the latte I purchased!

Atmosphere was great and food was ok. But it was super awkward when the waiter walks up to you and says “time finished”. I was at the place for max 2 hrs at that point. If you have a time limit for customers , then have a sign somewhere or ask me to buy more drinks, I don’t mind. It wasn’t even that busy at the time, since many tables had left so there were empty tables. Bummer because I initially liked the place.

Me and my fiancé stayed here 3 nights and overall the experience wasn’t horrible but it wasn’t great either. The hotel is large and looks fancy but the room although spacious was outdated. There was brass everywhere and you can tell by looking at it that the brass isn’t maintained very well. everything was good. i advice you to visit this place because

1454.ed: Diners like this restaurant's delicious and flavorful jjukumi, which features tender baby octopus and a satisfying spicy kick, along with tasty fried rice. They also highlight the casual, welcoming atmosphere and the staff who cook the food at the table. Some reviews mention the service can be inefficient.
1454.edj: この韓国料理店を訪れたユーザーは、やわらかいイイダコと満足感のある辛さが特徴のチュクミや、おいしいチャーハンを高く評価しています。また、カジュアルで親しみやすい雰囲気や、スタッフが目の前で料理してくれる点も好評のようです。 一部のクチコミでは、スタッフの対応が丁寧でないという意見もあります。

rv.t: I went there about 2 weeks ago. As a Korean, I can tell the food at this restaurant are very authentic and great. Even the atmosphere gave me a bit the "korean vibe". Even though I couldn't speak Japanese well, the staff were very courtesy.
I really liked the local atmosphere and the food we ordered was delicious.

ランチで利用。 新大久保でチュクミを食べたいと思い、有名チェーンで安定感がありそうだったので予約して来店しました。 到着時にはすでに外に行列ができており、予約していて正解。路面店で入りやすく、店員さんが目の前で調理してくれるスタイルも楽しいです。 チュゴプセはイイダコ・ホルモン・エビ入りで、サムギョプサルをトッピング。辛さは普通でも辛ラーメンより少し辛めですが、旨みがしっかりあります。 〆のとびこチャーハンまで含めて満足度高め。 チェーン店ならではの安定した美味しさで、チュクミ初心者にもおすすめのお店だと思います。

1455.ed: Diners like this Vietnamese restaurant's delicious banh mi, which features fresh ingredients and a great balance of flavors, and the flavorful pho with a gentle taste. They also highlight the cozy and stylish atmosphere, along with the friendly staff.
1455.edj: このベトナム料理店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、新鮮な食材と味のバランスが良いバインミー、そして優しい味付けのフォーが美味しいと評判です。また、居心地の良いおしゃれな雰囲気と、親しみやすいスタッフも高く評価されています。

rv.t: I went with my girlfriend and for starters we each ordered a drink. I got the homemade ginger ale and she got the Tahiti lime Soda. The ginger ale was quite good and was on the dry/spicy side tasting like actual ginger root. Her lime drink was quite sour, but in a good way. Sizes were just a tad smaller than I would’ve liked. As for food I got the pork banh mi and I added the egg topping. The ingredient quality was…

I love the grit they exude by exclaiming that they are Vietnamese but not Vietnamese. Indeed, this isn’t a place for you to seek authentic Vietnamese food. You will instead get decent Japanese food which is crafted by someone who understands Vietnamese flavours and possesses enough appreciation of them to create something utterly different. The chicken pho and the chicken bun bo hue are tasty, their hot broth warms…

Went on a weeknight after work. It was empty; I was the only one. I ordered an original banh mi. It was good but unusual. The pate was watery, and the sandwich had dill and peanuts. They make you wait outside in the heat while they prepare your take away order even if the restaurant is empty. I paid with a card. I won't return for the service.

The hike to the pond is amazing but the pond itself is the least maintained part of the park, not impressive in my opinion, and the fact that they charge extra for admission is honestly embarrassing. Enjoy the hike itself and skip the pond!
Myojin pond is one of the attractions in kamikochi. Came here after a long walk from the entrance

rv.t: Stepping into Kamikochi’s alpine valley, I was immediately enchanted by Taisho Ike Pond, a breathtaking natural masterpiece born from volcanic power. Formed in 1915 when an eruption of nearby Mount Yakedake dammed the Azusa River, this crystal-clear lake stands as a stunning testament to nature’s creative and destructive forces ￼￼￼. Its most distinctive feature is the skeletal dead trees standing silently in the…

First drop off station of Kamikochi. Most of people start at here and walk across the forest to Kappa bridge. You will get welcome with the pond reflected the mountian and sky like mirror. Very impressive. To come to Kamikochi by bus recommend to book ticket in advance.
We get off at this pond on our way from shin shimashima station. Beautiful cloudy and full of tranquility, its foggy weather enhanced its mystical surroundings ambience

Went there on a rainy/snowy day, and the next day with fine weather. 2 different views. Beautiful.
My favourite place of Kamikochi. Serene and picturesque view especially in the morning when the sunlight shines onto the snow range and the ike.

The menu offers two distinct poles, two different ways to interact with the world: the Chintan (Clear Broth) and the Noko-Shantan (Rich Superior Broth). The Chintan is the broth of the intellectual. It is a masterpiece of subtraction, a transparent window that requires nothing but the…
A casual place for delicious wonton and noodles. The flavors are delicious and the shoyu broth is rich and savory but not heavy. Portions are large and inexpensive. Payment is cash or PayPay only.

this place is so goood the gyoza was nice and crispy the braised pork rice was great and salty and soooo melt in your mouth with how tender the pork was the wantanmen itself - yummy! portion was very filling and love the set of an entree with a small appetizer depending on what set you get would love to return again! first time goers - it’s cash only but don’t worry there’s a 7/11 next door my only gripe is the…

rv.t: Good pho chain that seems popular with both locals and foreigners, with delicious broth. They also have egg yolks cooked in the pho broth that was delicious and added something different that I'd not tried before. My only criticism is that the portions are quite small. Even the pho noodles that are cheap seemed sparse, and I left still feeling a little hungry.

I ate phở here — it has the famous flavor of Hanoi, Vietnam. I ordered a large bowl with lots of green onions, but in reality, it had fewer green onions than expected. Price: 65,000 VND. You can also order an extra bowl with egg for 10,000 VND. It was quite delicious.

The owner is helpful and polite. The foods are delicious. But for pho, there is only beef pho, no other meat. So if you cannot/dont eat beef and want to try pho, better go another place. But! The pork soup!!!!! You can order!!!!! It's really goooooooood. 👍🏻 Oh! The seafood spring roll too 👍🏻 Nice place to go :)

1462.a: New Chiang Mai, 1 Chome-2-5 103 Yakumo, Meguro City, Tokyo 152-0023, Japan
1462.aj: 〒152-0023 東京都目黒区八雲１丁目２−5 103 ニューチェンマイタイ料理
1462.ed: Diners like this restaurant's authentic Thai cuisine, especially the rich and creamy beef shank khao soi and flavorful green curry. They also highlight the tender beef and pork in their dishes, along with the generous portions. Guests mention the staff are welcoming and the atmosphere is suitable for a quick meal.
1462.edj: このタイ料理店を利用したユーザーのクチコミでは、本格的なタイ料理が高く評価されています。特に、濃厚でクリーミーな牛すね肉のカオソーイや、風味豊かなグリーンカレーが人気です。また、料理に使われている牛肉や豚肉が柔らかいこと、そしてボリュームがあることも特徴として挙げられています。スタッフは親しみやすく、店の雰囲気は手早く食事を済ませるのに適しているという声もあります。

rv.t: A great spot for Thai food. Super small with only 10 seats. It has the traditional Thai menu, but with a Chiang Mai twist. Khao Soi is one of my favorite dishes and the one here was a solid rendition. The owners and staff were absolutely wonderful. Very approachable and accommodating. Worth a stop.

Very good neighbourhood Thai restaurant located on the north side of Toritsudaigaku. Small setting with six tables, serving Chiang Mai style food. Good value lunch sets. Green curry was tasty, creamy and had a kick.
You are required to order a drink for dinner. Great Pad Thai - would certainly love to come back for. Tom Yum soup was a bit too spicy for me, and a bit greasy. Highly recommend pad thai.

1462.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1463.a: Seokbulsa, 143-79 Mandeokgogae-gil, Buk-gu, Busan, South Korea
1463.aj: 石仏寺 １４３−７９ Mandeokgogae-gil, Buk-gu, Busan, 韓国
1463.ed: Mountainside Buddhist temple & hiking destination known for its relief carvings on the cliff walls.

rv.t: Stunning carvings set atop a mountain temple. You can take a taxi up and walk down if the hike is too strenuous.

It's not worth the strenuous climb of about 1.5 km to get there. The stone carvings are nice, but the temple itself is very small and, in my opinion, doesn't even begin to compare in beauty to the Buddhist temples you can visit in Kyoto and the rest of Japan. Even the trail to get there, although it passes through a forest, isn't at all a nature experience, given the presence of paved roads, public restrooms…
One of the highlands of our visit to Busan and it was on my list of places to visit. Highly recommend, probably the most unique Buddhist temple we saw and we visited quite a few in Asia.

1464.a: Samgwangsa, 77 Choeupcheon-ro 43beon-gil, Busanjin District, Busan, South Korea
1464.aj: 三光寺 ７７ Choeupcheon-ro 43beon-gil, Busanjin District, Busan, 韓国

rv.t: I went for Buddhas birthday, and it was absolutely incredible. It is a MUST SEE, out of this world. If your thinking of going just to see the temples, I would also reccomend, it is absolutely gorgeous, and personally one of my favourite temples in Korea. It has 2 golden phoenix statues that are my favourite features, a detail easy to miss but so beautiful. Dont forget to be respectful as this is an active praying…

Very close to the city, easy to visit. Would recommend to visit here. I took 10 minutes to climb the hill from an elementary school, 40 minutes to look around. There is a bus 부산진구15 (Busan Jingu 15) that goes up to front of the temple from Lotter department store Seomyeon. Around 10am, a monk started to play a korean trumpet (i don't know the exact name). I have no idea of the meaning. Maybe he was just practicing…

Visited on Buddha’s Birthday, and it was truly a beautiful experience. The temple was decorated with what seemed like thousands of colorful lanterns-perhaps close to 10,000-creating a breathtaking atmosphere. Beyond the stunning views, it is a wonderful place to find peace, reflect, and calm the mind through meditation. The serene surroundings and spiritual ambiance make Samgwangsa Temple a must-visit destination…

1465.a: Haedong Yonggungsa Temple, 86 Yonggung-gil, Gijang-gun, Busan, South Korea
1465.aj: 海東龍宮寺 ８６ Yonggung-gil, Gijang-gun, Busan, 韓国
1465.ed: Enduring Buddhist temple constructed in the 14th-century & offering sweeping views of the sea.
1465.edj: 海を一望できる 14 世紀建立の仏教寺院。

rv.t: It was really nice to come here after a long day of walking around. I would recommend bringing some money so you can purchase a packet of salt. Being honest more than half of the time I spent here would have been throwing coins into the little game on the side of the hill. I didn’t get one in but I had lots of fun. I hope too many of the coins aren’t washing out to see and then turtles eat them.

The most beautiful temple I've visited in South Korea. 🏯✨ The view was absolutely stunning, and the whole place felt so peaceful and relaxing. I'm really glad I came. 😇🙏 I visited during the day, but I think it would be just as beautiful at night too. Definitely a must-visit if you're in Busan! 💯🍀

This is one of the most beautiful temples I’ve ever been to in Korea. And I’ve been to many different temples here in this country. Located very close to the beach, it has stunning views and easy access. I’d say it’s definitely worth going out of your way to come here because the views, atmosphere and everything is second to none.

1466.a: Parlor Vinefru Ginza shave ice, ＧＹＢトマトハウス 3F 1 Chome-20-10 Ginza, Chuo City, Tokyo 104-0061, Japan
1466.aj: 〒104-0061 東京都中央区銀座１丁目２０−１０ ＧＹＢトマトハウス 3F VINEFRU 銀座
catj: デザート ショップ
1466.ed: People say this cafe offers delicious, fluffy pancakes and unique, refreshing kakigori with seasonal fruit and inventive flavor combinations. They also highlight the polite and kind staff, who provide excellent service and an English menu. Visitors appreciate the cozy atmosphere and the option to reserve a table, especially during busy periods.
1466.edj: このカフェを利用した人からは、ふわふわで美味しいパンケーキや、旬のフルーツを使った独創的なかき氷が評判のようです。特に、季節ごとに変わるユニークなフレーバーの組み合わせが好評です。また、スタッフの丁寧で親切な接客も高く評価されており、英語のメニューも用意されているため、海外からの利用者も安心して楽しめるという声が多くあります。居心地の良い雰囲気も魅力で、特に混雑時には予約ができる点も喜ばれています。

rv.t: This has to be one of the best Kakigori places I have been to. I have been all over Japan and I always look for Kakigori, no matter how hot or cold it is outside. During my last trip, we were in Tokyo for a week and we ate here about three times. We even had our 1 year old in a stroller and I carried him up those narrow tiny stairs three times because this place was that good. It is a smaller spot counter seating…

Absolutely the best pancakes I've ever had in my 50 years! They were light, fluffy, pillowy and decadent. I ordered the pistachio strawberry (which I wasn't going to order because they seemed "heavy" - and they were anything but heavy! I practically licked the plate clean and would've eaten 3 more if I wasn't running late (and worried about the waistline!) The staff was kind and service was quick. I will be back…

I came with my boyfriend looking for souffle pancakes and we were surprised to see that this place also served shaved ice! We ordered the kinako mochi shaved ice and the strawberry pistachio panckaes. The mochi was incredibly soft and the shaved ice was perfectly light! The pancakes were fluffy and everything tasted delicious :) we were seated on the open balcony with a view of the city as well. This is a new…

1466.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 11:00

1467.a: GINGER GRASS modern thai vietnamese, 1階 2 Chome-2-1 Yoyogi, Shibuya, Tokyo 151-0053, Japan
1467.aj: 〒151-0053 東京都渋谷区代々木２丁目２−１ 1階 GINGER GRASS modern thai vietnamese
1467.ed: Diners praise this restaurant's delicious Thai and Vietnamese offerings, including flavorful curries and spring rolls, alongside generous portions and reasonable prices. The excellent service and good resort-like atmosphere further enhance the dining experience, making it suitable for various occasions. Some reviews mention the service can be rushed.
1467.edj: クチコミによると、このレストランの美味しいタイ料理とベトナム料理は、風味豊かなカレーや生春巻きを含め、高く評価されています。ボリュームたっぷりの料理と手頃な価格も好評です。素晴らしいサービスとリゾートのような雰囲気も、食事体験をさらに良くしており、様々な場面で利用しやすいという声が多くあります。 一部のクチコミでは、サービスが急かされているように感じることがあるという意見もあります。

rv.t: We were visiting Japan from Australia and celebrated a family member’s birthday here. Gloria went above and beyond to make the evening special — she helped organise a lovely birthday plate and made everything seamless. Communication was easy, and she was warm, attentive, and incredibly helpful throughout. The food was excellent — we ordered Khao Soi, bites, and glass noodles, and much more... everything was…

The people, the welcome, the atmosphere, the food. I’m a total seafood hater, so I ordered the phat Thai…it was all seafood. I tried it and I’m so glad I did. As good as most Thai food from Thailand, speaking from experience. Also ordered the mango piña colada and it came in a cute pineapple cup and was delicious. Very reasonably priced for the amount of food they give you in a lunch set. Would definitely go again…

Cosy and well ventilated dining space. Thai Grilled Chicken was flavourful and tender. Khao Soi Curry Noddles was delicious but will be perfect if curry was of a thicker consistency. Chicken Pho was refreshing and will be better if side pair with more herbs. The Viet style salad roll was perfect!

1468.aj: Nem Chua Ran Store - 36 Tam Thuong, 36 Ng. Tạm Thương, Phố cổ Hà Nội, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 10000 ベトナム

rv.t: Found this place by accident, I fancied some sweet potato as a change from the usual Vietnamese food. This alley is amazing, not many western tourists here. But still very busy. I got the sweet potato fries, they were perfect for my craving. I love how you can put your own amount of salt on them. The staff were very friendly and patient with me as I ordered. I loved the atmosphere of people walking and driving their…

Loved this place, real buzzing vibe and loads of locals eating here and all down this side street. I had to actually order a takeaway as needed to grab dinner and eat back home while doing some work, they packed me up the whole meal with all the condiments in no time and was perfect for me. Food was delicious and good sized portions and very reasonable prices. I ordered the combo 1 and had never had fermented pork…

Yet another nem chua ran (fried fermented pork roll) spot in Tam Thuong alley. This one is less crowded than the others, so the service is fast and the indoor seating is spacious and airy. As for the nem chua, they all taste pretty much the same anyway.

1468.stj: 営業時間外 · 営業開始: 8:00

1469.a: Hoa Lu Ancient Capital, Tây Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, Vietnam
1469.aj: 古都ホアルー Tây Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, ベトナム
1469.ed: Ancient capital dating back to the 10th century, packed with temple & fortress ruins.
1469.edj: 10 世紀に王朝が築かれた古都。寺院や要塞の遺跡がある。

rv.t: Visiting the Hoa Lu Ancient Capital was one of the true highlights of my trip to Ninh Binh. The moment you walk towards the grand stone entrance gate, you can deeply feel the rich history and incredible cultural heritage of Vietnam. The entire site is beautifully preserved and surrounded by stunning, dramatic limestone mountains that create a breathtaking backdrop, especially during the golden hour as the sun goes…

DO NOT RENT A BICYCLE IT IS COMPLETELY UNNECESSARY Outside of the bike scam unfortunately we were not very impressed by this ancient site. We enjoyed the surrounding limestone formations more than the site its self. vnd 20k per adult entry 10k for motorcycle parking and we got scammed 30k per bike (I haggled her down from 50k). If you've seen other pagodas in Vietnam your not missing a whole lot if you dont come…

From 968 to 1009, Hoa Lu was the capital of Vietnam. I expected this place to be bigger, but the actual area you pay to visit is quite small. There's two temples, an archeological exhibition (only place that had AC here) and a viewpoint that you must climb to get to. There were lots of tour groups with guides. Going with a guide is probably better because I couldn't see much written information here. Only go here…

1470.a: Motsusen Akasaka Honten, 高橋ビル ２F 2 Chome-14-12 Akasaka, Minato City, Tokyo 107-0052, Japan
1470.aj: 〒107-0052 東京都港区赤坂２丁目１４−１２ 高橋ビル ２F もつ千 赤坂本店
1470.ed: People say this restaurant offers fresh offal dishes, including a variety of flavorful meat sashimi and tender motsu stew. They also highlight the reasonable prices, lively atmosphere, and efficient tablet ordering system. Some reviews mention the atmosphere can be noisy.
1470.edj: 和テイストな店内は屋台風のカジュアルな雰囲気。ハチノスのトマト煮込みなど、モツ料理も提供している。飲み放題プランあり。

rv.t: Has English menu. Mostly serving tongue, offal.. We only eat breast/ thigh meat and this place is able to cater for it! We love the garlic fried rice as well. Recommend to pay a visit! Lots of locals dine here. They don’t have the necessary packaging to take out, they will offer a plastic bag.
Extremely friendly staff, fun crowd, great spot for some late snacks and beer. All the food we ate was delicious. The beer was creamy and smooth. No complaints at all.
Very tasty food with nice drinks to have together with. In the evening it gets very crowded and there might a queue to get a seat, but it's definitely worth the wait!

1471.aj: 7W39+HF Trang An Grottoes tour, Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, ベトナム

rv.t: Trang An is so lovely. The scenery is absolutely stunning. Surrounded by mountains, rivers, and nature, I really felt so small in the middle of such beautiful landscapes. I took Route 1 and Route 3, which were both quite nice. I went with some older ladies, and we spent around 2 hours finishing both routes while chatting along the way. The boat rower was very friendly, cheerful, and gentle. The views were…

Trang An is a UNESCO World Heritage Site, and taking a boat ride is by far the best way to experience it! It's about a 2.5 to 3 hour ride and costs 300 dong for adults. It's 4 people per boat so we shared ours which we didn't mind! Motorbike parking is also free. Just ride through the entrance, collect a parking ticket, and park up. We really appreciated that it was free and felt happy knowing our bike was safe. We…

Visited here in the January, 2026. I was the first person to buy the ticket that morning. I have taken the route no.2. I have waited for 5 mins till the another two persons joined the boat. The boat tour started somewhere around 7:30. Ours is the first boat and the entire route is literally for us till we returned at around 9:10. Amazing views. After reaching the ending point I have seen the flocks of tourists. the…

1472.aj: 2W64+H87 Trúc Lâm Sùng Phúc Zen Monastery, ĐT378, Long Biên, Hà Nội 100000 ベトナム

rv.t: Study Buddhism but impolite and unwelcoming way of talking. I met 2 person and decided not to take a step inside.
Great
A quite place where you can meditate, which has become rare in the Hanoi. Cleanliness and lack of commercial activities also a major plus

1473.a: Tieu Dao Buddhist Temple, Thôn Đ. Giang Cao, Gia Lâm, Hà Nội, Vietnam
1473.aj: Tieu Dao Buddhist Temple, Thôn Đ. Giang Cao, Gia Lâm, Hà Nội, ベトナム

rv.t: The temple belongs to the best that were built in the last years new.The people care of every detail for keeping the place in the good shape. The main part is really impressive. The area is large and the buildings are spread quite smart that there still a useful square in the middle left.
I went there early in the morning of New Years day. It was quiet and lots of unique things. Especially the decoration in front of the temple is beautiful.
Buddhist temple. Very well maintained. Natural environment.

1475.a: Lò Bầu cổ - old dragon kiln for pottery production, 51 Đ. Bát Tràng, thôn 1, Bát Tràng, Hà Nội 132109, Vietnam
1475.aj: Lò Bầu cổ - old dragon kiln for pottery production, 51 Đ. Bát Tràng, thôn 1, Bát Tràng, Hà Nội 132109 ベトナム

rv.t: A Hidden Cultural Gem in Hanoi – A Must Visit Experience! A truly unforgettable cultural experience at Lò Bầu cổ - Old Dragon Kiln for Pottery Production. This place is much more than a pottery workshop — it feels like stepping into living history. Watching the ancient dragon kiln, learning about the traditional ceramic production process, and seeing how generations preserved this beautiful craft was genuinely…
I absolutely loved our experience here doing the pottery wheel and painting our pots afterwards. They were very helpful and it was a great way to experience the pottery village before walking around.
Nice place to visit. Some small ceramic shops and workshops inside the area

1476.a: XWG6+9XF Chợ gốm Bát Tràng, Đ. Chợ Gốm, Bát Tràng, Hà Nội, Vietnam
1476.aj: XWG6+9XF Chợ gốm Bát Tràng, Đ. Chợ Gốm, Bát Tràng, Hà Nội, ベトナム
1476.ed: Traditional porcelain & other ceramics are made & sold at this market for a timeless village.
1476.edj: 伝統的な磁器などの陶芸品の工房と販売店がある、レトロな雰囲気の村の市場。

rv.t: Bat Trang Pottery Market offers a charming glimpse into Vietnam's centuries-old ceramic tradition. Wander through shops filled with handcrafted pottery, decorative items and local handicrafts, and enjoy the opportunity to watch artisans at work or even try making your own pottery piece.

Broad selection of locally made pottery ranging from uber-kitsch to elegant. Something for everyone across 100+ stalls and adjacent shops. Friendly merchants. Very fair prices. A few food options. -1 ⭐️ because toilets are hard to find and not well-stocked (bring your own 🧻 and hand sanitizer or better yet go to a restaurant for that).

This is very nice place and the best part is it is not that touristy so the price so far is not that insane as others tourist places in Vietnam. The price for souvenirs can be varied depends on the position of the shop so asking price in many places to get the best price. To sum up, this is very nice place to visit in Hanoi

1477.a: Bat Trang Pottery Museum, thôn 5 Đ. Bát Tràng, Bát Tràng, Hưng Yên, Vietnam
1477.aj: バッチャン陶芸博物館 thôn 5 Đ. Bát Tràng, Bát Tràng, Hưng Yên, ベトナム

rv.t: Really enjoyed this museum. Beautifully designed from the outside, different levels of exhibitions for ceramics stories and history. I totally loved the light show on level 3 - a must see! Had a good time trying tea on the 5th floor and bought some cute ceramics items back. For families, can try making your own ceramic bowls/glasses on the ground floor. Totally recommended for a quick 1.5-2 hours visit.

This was a delightful surprise visit. Although it’s a bit further from the usual Hanoi attractions, it’s definitely worth it if you’re looking to escape the hustle and bustle and find some tranquility. I highly recommend the ticket that grants access to all floors. The rooftop access is particularly great for unwinding and enjoying the serene garden while sipping on their refreshing cold tea. The highlight exhibit…

Overall, this is a very interesting museum with a reasonable entrance fee. I highly recommend getting the full package, as it includes a pottery-making activity. For someone like me who had never tried pottery before, it was a truly impressive and fun experience. If you buy the all-access ticket, you can also visit the rooftop area, where there is a space to sit and enjoy herbal tea. I’m not sure what herbs were…

1478.a: Nhà Thờ Lớn Hà Nội, 1 P. Nhà Thờ, Phường, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000, Vietnam
1478.aj: Nhà Thờ Lớn Hà Nội, 1 P. Nhà Thờ, Phường, Hoàn Kiếm, Hà Nội 100000 ベトナム
1478.ed: The Neo-Gothic design of this 1886 Catholic cathedral, the city's oldest church, echoes Notre Dame.
1478.edj: 1886 年に建てられたネオゴシック様式のカトリック大聖堂。ハノイ最古の教会で、パリのノートルダム大聖堂をモデルとして建立された。

rv.t: A beautiful and historic church in the heart of Hanoi and one of the city’s most notable landmarks. The architecture is impressive with a classic Gothic design that resembles European cathedrals, and the front square creates a nice open space to relax and take photos. It’s a great place to visit if you want to learn a bit about the history of Christianity in Vietnam and admire the old architectural details inside…

St. Joseph's Cathedral is a beautiful and peaceful place right in the heart of Hanoi. The architecture is stunning, with a classic old European style that really stands out from the busy surroundings. The atmosphere around the cathedral is lively, with small cafés and shops nearby, making it a great spot to relax and soak in the vibe of the city. Inside, it feels calm and spiritual, offering a nice break from the…

St. Joseph's Cathedral is a must-see when you're wandering around Hanoi. The weathered, neo-Gothic exterior is striking. It feels like a stunning piece of European history right in the middle of a bustling tropical city. The details on the facade and the twin towers are beautiful, especially when the afternoon light hits them. A quick practical tip if you want to explore the inside: definitely check the visitor…

1479.a: Hoa Lu Old town, Tràng An 2, Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, Vietnam
1479.aj: Hoa Lu Old town, Tràng An 2, Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, ベトナム

rv.t: A very nice place to visit when staying in Ninh Binh. Make sure to visit the temple area. It is a beautiful and peaceful place, especially combined with the lake scenery around it. The atmosphere in the evening is very relaxing and it is a great place to walk around and take your time. The night market next to the lake offers a lot of food options. My recommendation: don't just walk around, grab some local food and…

I visited this place while basing itself at Tam Coc. It's a 20min bike ride by Grab from Tam Coc to Hoa Lu. The whole ambience of the Old Town was great. The lanterns and night lightings were perfect. The atmosphere was lively with many shops and restaurants. You can easily spend the entire night here. There are also massage shops if you need a back rub or foot massage. I was there on a Sunday evening and both banks…

A beautiful place to visit in the evening when it really comes alive! We arrived at around 4pm and loved watching everything gradually come to life. The restaurants were setting up, the photo booths were getting ready, and the boats were preparing for the evening. As the sun started to set, all the lanterns and lights turned on, completely transforming the area. It felt like a mini Hoi An! The pagodas are stunning…

1480.a: Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc (Động Am Tiên), Tây Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, Vietnam
1480.aj: Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc (Động Am Tiên), Tây Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, ベトナム
1480.ed: Sprawling urban park with a vast pond, a swimming pool & soccer fields, plus kids' play equipment.

rv.t: Such a great place to visit! Super peaceful and just gorgeous. I didn’t know what to expect but it’s basically a really beautiful lake that you can bike or walk around with a couple mini temples and a nice viewpoint. There are koi fish in the lake too and butterflies around. I would recommend walking unless you have mobility issues. I don’t think it’s necessary to rent a bike. One thing I would say is that there’s…

Tuyệt Tịnh Cốc (Am Tiên Cave) is a hidden gem that you shouldn't miss. To truly enjoy the beauty here, you must rent a bicycle and ride around the lake; it’s the best way to explore the many poetic and picturesque corners of the valley. I highly recommend climbing up to Am Tiên Cave. Not only can you learn about the historical and spiritual significance of the site, but you’ll also be rewarded with a breathtaking…

Confused my the overrated or overpriced comments! This was an amazing viewpoint with an awesome cave temple. It’s like four dollars and there’s really no need to rent a bike. You can easily walk around the lake the the hike to the viewpoint is up stairs and pretty easy. This wasn’t on my original itinerary and my Airbnb host told me about it and glad she did.

1481.a: 6WW4+C25 Suối Tiên Temple, Tràng An, Nam Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, Vietnam
1481.aj: 6WW4+C25 Suối Tiên Temple, Tràng An, Nam Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, ベトナム

rv.t: This peaceful island temple is a beautiful stop featured along the scenic Trang An boat routes (such as Routes 2 and 3). It offers a wonderful opportunity to step off the boat, walk across a charming bridge, and explore the beautifully manicured gardens. Surrounded by towering limestone karsts and gentle mountain breezes, it provides a very tranquil and highly photogenic setting that makes the entire boat excursion…

A stunning destination for visitors in route 2. You should prepare to charge the phone battery because you will use it constantly. I am really into the beauty of river and mountain, and the breezes of wind during our journey. Highly recommend to visit it.

This is one of the temples you’ll stop at on Route 2 of the Trang An river boat tour. The island where it located at is fairly big with some well tended garden and a bridge. The whole place is very peaceful even with quite some visitors, maybe because we visited on weekday.

1482.a: Bai Dinh Pagoda, Xóm 6, Tây Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, Vietnam
1482.aj: バイディン寺 Xóm 6, Tây Hoa Lư, Ninh Bình, ベトナム
1482.ed: Large pilgrimage site featuring an original Buddhist temple & newer pagodas in an open courtyard.
1482.edj: 建立当時のままの仏教寺院がある広大な巡礼地。開放的な中庭には新たに建造された仏塔がある。

rv.t: Absolutely worth visiting. Bai Dinh is a huge complex with beautiful temples, impressive halls and countless statues, both large and small. The surrounding nature makes the whole area feel peaceful and scenic. The large pagoda is the main highlight. You first have to climb a number of steps and then take a lift to the top. The views from the pagoda are beautiful and give you a great impression of the size of the…

We hadn’t planned to come here, just decided randomly on a rainy morning and….it was one of the highlights of our time in Ninh Binh! Beautiful place! We kinda got scammed tho haha, the ladies in the reception did some upselling and we weren’t really sure of what they were offering or saying, but definitely worth it! We payed for both the Valley and Pagoda tickets. The Valley is definitely quieter, and it was nice to…

Bai Dinh Pagoda is huge, so expect a lot of walking. I recommend taking the electric car if you want to see more of the complex while saving time and energy. Some ticket packages also include a relaxing herbal foot bath. If you choose the 150,000 VND or 200,000 VND packages, you’ll walk much more, but you’ll get to enjoy each stop at a slower pace. The grounds are spacious, peaceful, and full of greenery, making it…

rv.t: Really small train station, it’s the only one in Ninh Binh. There’s a great minimart inside that takes cash and card. plus a tourist centre. They sell booze and hot foods. Beers are 20k and all snacks are reasonably priced, the same price as in the touristy areas in town. Theres a western toilet (bring your own TP) No ATM onsite.
Sleeper train from Ninh Binh to Da Nang around 15hours and cost around 1.400.000 dong. Cleanliness must improved for long rides.

I traveled from Da Nang to Ninh Binh. Train left Da Nang at 7:00 pm. Which reached in Ninh Binh at 11:30 the next day. The journey was good, but it took a lot of time. The train had to stop at various places. There was nothing else to eat in the train except noodle packets..!👍

rv.t: 461 stairs till the main top. 407 stairs till smaller top. Crossing is at 278. Left goes up to main top. A small shop with water and snacks at 307. Entrance fee 150 at the moment. Be careful if you climb up till the dragon, it is very slippery stones and pretty dangerous to fall. Not recommended to let children go up. Stairs are most of the way pretty good but in the end can be more high. A few benches exist but not…

It's a short and easy hike that offers very nice views of the surrounding area. When you start going up there will be a point where you can go right or left, go right first and enjoy the view there, after that go back down and walk up the other side, that's were you'll find the best view! It seemed a bit dangerous climbing around the dragon statue, only do it if you are fit. Entrance fee to Hang Múa is 150K.

AMAZING! This is the third time I have been here. The views are incredible- a must See when visiting Ninh Binh. The entrance is more built up than when I last came - with bars, restaurants ans even a spa. Nice to see a drink stop on the way up too. Stairs are steep and not for the faint hearted in the heat but just go slow its worth the effort!

The Temple of Emperor Đinh Tiên Hoàng is a fascinating historical site and an important part of Vietnam's rich heritage. Dedicated to Emperor Đinh Tiên Hoàng, who unified Vietnam and founded the Đinh Dynasty, the temple offers visitors a chance to learn about a significant chapter in the country's history. The temple complex is beautifully preserved and showcases traditional Vietnamese architecture, intricate…

Beautiful architecture. The pond with the fishes is very pretty. Going with a tour group in an air conditioned coach is recommended as it is very hot there on motorbikes. Bring hats and cooling neck fan. You have to cover your knees at certain entries but they have long skirts to borrow. rv.t: This temple is very beautiful, and it has spectacular views from the bridge. It was nice to see the turtles and learn about the history and cultural importance of the lake turtles. The inside of the temple grounds is small so the ₫50,000 per person (foreigner) seemed a bit high. I recommend going late in the evening or early in the morning for the best views and less crowds.

Ngoc Son Temple is a peaceful and beautiful site located on a small island in the middle of Hoan Kiem Lake. Its iconic red bridge and traditional architecture make it very photogenic. Walking to the temple while enjoying the lake views is a pleasant experience, and the area offers a nice escape from the busy streets of Hanoi. In the evening, the atmosphere becomes even more vibrant, with a night market surrounding…

Ngoc Son Temple was a lovely place to visit and felt much more interesting once I understood a bit more about its history and symbolism. Reading about the turtles in the lake, the legend of the returned sword, and the stories tied to the temple added a lot to the experience and made it feel more than just a quick sightseeing stop. What I especially liked was taking time to look at the smaller details across the…

rv.t: If you are looking for a profound sense of peace amidst the vibrant and fast-paced chaos of Hanoi, the Temple of Literature is an absolute must-visit. I arrived here around 3:00 PM, which turned out to be the absolute perfect timing. Surprisingly, there weren't many people around, allowing me to fully absorb the deeply magical atmosphere of the grounds without feeling rushed. The energy here is truly amazing—you can…

A fascinating window into 1,000 years of Vietnamese academic and intellectual history. The Temple of Literature is set on beautifully landscaped grounds — well maintained and genuinely serene despite the chaos of Hanoi. The exhibitions are well laid out and easy to follow, taking you through the site's history as Vietnam's first national university. What made it particularly memorable was watching people engaged…

★★★★☆ (4/5 Stars) The Temple of Literature in Hanoi is a beautiful and historically significant landmark that offers a fascinating glimpse into Vietnam's rich cultural and educational heritage. The architecture is well preserved, and the peaceful gardens provide a relaxing escape from the city's busy streets. I enjoyed exploring the courtyards and learning about the country's first university and its scholarly…

rv.t: Located just a few steps from the Ho Chi Minh Mausoleum and the Ho Chi Minh Museum, One Pillar Pagoda (Chua Mot Cot) is a small structure with an enormous soul. Despite its modest size, the pagoda carries nearly a thousand years of history and remains one of the most recognizable symbols of Hanoi. Standing before it, I felt how deeply Vietnamese culture blends spirituality, architecture, and everyday life. Built in…

Visited the One Pillar Pagoda and it’s definitely a must-visit place if you want to truly experience and understand the cultural and historical essence of the spot. The entire area is surrounded by lush greenery, making it very peaceful and refreshing—check out the photos I’ve posted, they capture the vibe really well. As expected, the architecture is absolutely stunning. Simple yet meaningful, and you can feel the…

A quiet and peaceful place - renowned for its unique architeture. This historic Buddhist temple stands on a single stone pillar, supposedly signifying peace. The Pagoda was originally built in the mid 11th century and has since undergone many changes.

rv.t: The Ho Chi Minh Stilt House in Hanoi offers a brief yet meaningful glimpse into the life of Vietnam’s most iconic leader. Nestled within a serene compound, the house is remarkably well maintained, preserving the simplicity and modesty that characterized Ho Chi Minh’s lifestyle. Visitors are not allowed to enter the actual living quarters, and guards are present to ensure the premises remain respected and…
A nicely maintained house with Vietnamese heritage. A nice walk around the area and presidential palace. Worth a visit once.

Located on the back side of the mausoleum. This is where President Ho lived a simple life. This place was built by the local Vietnamese people as a gift to Ho Chi Minh, for his contributions to the country. The place houses few cars which he used to ride, for both longer and shorter rides. There is a koi fish pond which is worth a watch as well.

rv.t: You really can’t beat this hotel for the price. I paid around ₩92,000 per night for a deluxe double non-smoking room with a beach view, and at that price point, it was easily one of the best accommodations we had in South Korea. The room was spotless and quite spacious. Amenities were well provided, with plenty of storage space. The shower had great water pressure and reliable hot water. Proper towels and bathrobes…

We enjoyed our one-night stay here. The weather was good in late-mid February and the room was pretty comfortable. The hotel is well-located near the cable car, beach, and plenty of restaurants and walking paths. There is a convenience store on the first floor if you need something late at night. Nice restaurant with very good food! The staff was a little confused and managed to forget our third order twice. Nevertheless we've had our main dishes and were already satisfied. Prices are of course higher than on the street but food quality is significantly better too. Recommendable of you like to try Hải Phòng cuisine (lots of seafood).

rv.t: Delicious beef pho near Old Quarter for a great price. I went twice while I was in the city and it did not disappoint either time! The man serving the pho is super nice. The line may be 5-10 people long, but it moves extremely fast. Once you order, you’ll get your food within 2-3 minutes. It will be piping hot and flavorful! Be prepared to share a table with strangers and sit wherever there is space available.

With only three options on the menu and a Michelin rating, you’d think ordering would be straightforward. My spouse, who is from Vietnam, felt the staff’s attitude suggested we should be grateful just to dine here. We even had to fetch the soup ourselves while the entire team stood watching — it felt like a scene straight out of Seinfeld’s ‘Soup Nazi.’ As for the pho, it was oily, heavy on ginger, and my palate…

Very nice local spot. Very affordable (about £3.40 total for what you see in the photo). We were shown exactly what each dish would consist of before ordering, and it was ready extremely quick. rv.t: A long-standing local favorite in the Old Quarter. The broth is clear, naturally sweet, and well-balanced without being greasy. The noodles are pleasantly chewy, and the wontons are flavorful — simple ingredients done right. Prices are very affordable, especially for such a central location. It’s a true sidewalk eatery, offering an authentic Hanoi street food experience. Conveniently located near historic landmarks…

Chanced upon this on the last day of my trip. The dry rice noodle was the best out of the 4 dishes we ordered. Tangy savoury goodness. Add garlic water for extra kick. It was 50k dong a bowl. Would come back again!

Everything was good. The prawn soup so delicious and fragrance, but the prawn they never cleaned properly. Dining area quite comfortable. I went day 2 times, one time ordered soup another day ordered dry noodle. Overall okay.
